items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well I couldn't get up and I went up and played with him. Jim Robinson was with Young Morgan at that particular time. And then Andrew Morgan came in and they liked what I was doing and they hired me

ctx.x: On drums? No. Well that was something that went about that I said I couldn't play, which I couldn't. I did many times go to parties. And so finally one night, Young Morgan's band, he had his on band at that particular time, and I went to a party and the drummer got hooked. And so when I walked in, they said, well here come a drummer. Well I couldn't get up and I went up and played with him. Jim Robinson was with Young Morgan at that particular time. And then Andrew Morgan came in and they liked what I was doing…

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: They put me into the band, that's where I got Paul Bones and I got Kid Howard.

ctx.x: Let's see, we talked about recording too. That's another thing. Oh, oh Handy, we never did finish Handy. We better finish with it.

Where did you work with Handy? I worked with Handy. I worked with Handy at the Vida before I took the band in charge. I worked with Handy at the Vida. And after fired Handy, well they put me into the band, you see. They put me into the band, that's where I got Paul Bones and I got Kid Howard. Well they had, Shelly was playing trumpet then too. Shelly? Shelly, well they fired, the old man fired both of them fellas and he got handy in uh, in Kid Howard, old man's bikes.
Is that the Shelly that used to be with Paul Bones' Big Bam and in the, around Lake Charles, you know?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: It was me and George and Kid Howard.

ctx.x: Now, that man? Mm-hmm. We want his house. Oh! Many times I'm going to York, he got to go to his house. He lived, good off, um, that big square he lived off. Where is he parked? Yeah, that's right. He lived there. And the last time I was in New York, he come and got me, him and his wife, okay? It was me and George and Kid Howard. And man, what them people put on the table, then he had plenty of company drivers, you know? But Dad, they're supposed to eat and drink, man. That's a pretty story I see. Really, really,…

Well, he got an older boy too. I know, Peppa. Peppa. He's off. He's off. He was off in college. Oh, he was off in college, yeah. See, I wanted to ask you about Willie Foster. We were talking about him earlier, sales and on.
